guided.text: ▶️ Drag a card onto the field.
🏰 The enemy Castle. Break it to win.
⚔️ Cards hit the card in front of them. No card in front? They hit the Castle.
🃏 Your Deck. You draw 1 card each turn.
⏳ Your leader has to Wait. It attacks when this reaches 0.

guided.text: 👀 Watch it go down by 1 next round.

passive.text: ⏳ Wait: rounds until this card can attack.
